p3.text: My __(1)__ is a nurse at the big __(2)__ in town. She wears a blue __(3)__ every day. Her job is very __(4)__ but she is always __(5)__ to the sick children. Yesterday, my mum helped a little boy who broke his arm. She gave him a small present and a big smile. My mum is the best.

p4.title: What fire fighters do
p4.text: Firefighters have a very important and __(1)__ job. Their most important work is to put out fires __(2)__ houses, shops and forests. They __(3)__ a big red truck __(4)__ lots of water and special stairs. When there is a fire, they __(5)__ very quickly to help people. Firefighters __(6)__ special yellow clothes and a helmet __(7)__ keep them safe from the fire. They also help animals or people __(8)__ need help in __(9)__ places. To be a fire fighter, you must be __(10)__ strong and very brave.

parts.text: Two months ago, my dad opened a small bread shop on Queen Street. He has wanted to make bread in a shop since he was young, so we are all very happy for him. The name of the bread shop is "Sweet Morning" and it has a big yellow window. My dad wakes up every day at four o’clock to make bread. He makes 100 breads every morning. He also makes chocolate cakes, strawberry cakes and cookies. My favourite cookies are the ones with white chocolate chips. My big sister helps him on Saturdays. She puts the cakes in the shop window and she helps the people. Last Saturday, she helped more than fifty people! I can’t work in the bread shop yet because I’m only nine, but I help by tasting everything. That’s the best job!

items.s: What is the name of the bread shop?
At what time does dad wake up?
How much bread does he make?
How many people did she help last Saturday?
Why can’t the writer work there?

p6.title: My day
p6.text: Every school day, I wake __(0)__ at seven o’clock. I have breakfast with my family and __(1)__ I brush my teeth. I usually wear my blue school uniform. My mother takes me to school __(2)__ car. My first lesson starts at half past eight. I __(3)__ four lessons before lunch. In the afternoon, we __(4)__ maths and music. I come home at four and I play __(5)__ my dog, Bruno. Before dinner, I do my homework. At nine o’clock, I go to bed. I love my day.
